facts.text: Can we get ice cream after? My dad used to take me for ice cream and we always got chocolate.
facts.why: Not a line in the film. Russell does talk about ice cream at Fentons with his dad, but the real words are different: he always gets chocolate and his dad gets butter-brickle, then they sit on a curb.
facts.fix: I always get chocolate and he gets butter-brickle.

fix_note.text: I always get chocolate and he gets butter-brickle.

facts.text: Carl's lunch, the same since Ellie.
facts.why: The transcript and plot never show Carl eating toasties or keeping a daily lunch since Ellie, so the line claims something the film does not show.
facts.fix: Plain toasties for a quiet afternoon at home.

facts.text: Sipped on the porch while the house floats.
facts.why: Russell is on the porch as the house lifts off, but nobody sips tea there while it floats; the film has no such scene.
facts.fix: Tea for the long flight to Paradise Falls.

vibe.verdict: A tea room that fits Carl and Ellie's house well, with good props like the Ellie badge, Kevin's chocolate and Muntz's dinner.
